answer: The marble holds work receipts rather than names, so the vertex of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The ivory of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
